normalization_plan.reason: _owner is only a lookup key for balances in balanceOf and allowance.
_spender only identifies whose allowance entry is written by approve.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balance subtraction operation.
_from is only the source index for the balance and allowance reads in transferFrom.
_to is only the destination index credited in the transfer functions.
_extraData is forwarded verbatim into the unsafe external call payload.
